title: Vesper Crossroads - Quiet Hours at the Inn
_note: Hub mood sibling. Lonelier, lamplit, after-dark: same inn at 2am, one window still glowing. gbc 4-voice band. 96 BPM, 4/4, warm C major with one wistful turn to vi (Am). Vesper motif stretched/slowed, the settle-home phrase lingering on its final note before resolving - tender not chipper. lead=sparse pulse25, more rests, music-box. harmony=slow rolled arps, fewer notes, ringing longer. bass=half-note pillars, restful. drums=soft heartbeat-rate kick only. 16-bar loop. Last bar G(V) -> resolves to C bar 1.

tracks._note: Stretched Vesper motif, lots of rest. Bars 1-2 the lift, 3-4 the settle lingering. vi turn around bar 9-12.
